normalization_plan.reason: _mod only parameterizes the modulus calculation inside randomNum
_seed only parameterizes the hash input calculation inside randomNum
_salt only parameterizes the hash input calculation inside randomNum
value is the sole conversion operand of toString
_tokenId is only used to look up player data inside tokenURI
newOwner is the single argument forwarded by transferOwnership to _setOwner
supply is a transient cache of totalSupply used only inside mint
newPlayer is a transient struct materialized and stored only inside mint
num is the transient modulo result returned only by randomNum
